title: Lower density bound for cycles with the integer slice property (Simon 8.2 (2)–(6), corrected)
statement: Assume (REP), (MR), (SL), (DT) and (VO). Here (REP), (MR), (IMC), (SL), (DT), (VO) denote the exact frozen statements of the parent node's dependency theorems cmc_exists_massRepresentation, cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure, cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub, cmc_slice_mass_bounds, cmc_deformation_theorem and dtc_vanish_off_support; they are not available in this child's environment, so the needed ones appear verbatim as hypotheses of the Lean statement and are discharged by the parent proof. In words: (REP) a current with locally finite mass in an open U has a mass representation (μ, ξ) (μ(W) = M_W for open W, μ(ℝ^P∖U) = 0, μ finite on compacts of U, |ξ| ≤ 1, X(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ, and μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0 if also the boundary has locally finite mass); (MR) M_W(X) = R.measure(W) for an IMRep R of X and open W; (IMC) (a) locality of approximate tangent spaces for nested Borel sets, (b) the restriction of an IMRep to a Borel set is an IMRep of some current, (c) differences of IM currents are IM, (d) IMRep orientations satisfy |orient(x)(α)| ≤ |α| a.e.; (SL) slicing by an L-Lipschitz f of a current represented together with its boundary, with Z_t := ∂(X⌞{f<t}) − (∂X)⌞{f<t} vanishing on forms supported off {f = t}, M_W(Z_t) ≤ L liminf_h h⁻¹μ(W ∩ {t−h<f<t}) and the integrated bound; (DT) the deformation theorem with its mass and support bounds; (VO) a current vanishes on test forms whose support misses its support. For all P, d ∈ ℕ there is η₀ > 0 with the following property. A current Y ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P) has the integer slice property (ISP) if for all admissible representations (μ, ξ) of Y and (μ', ξ') of ∂Y in ℝ^P (Borel measures finite on compact sets; a.e. strongly measurable fields of (d+1)- resp. d-vectors with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| a.e.; Y(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ and ∂Y(η) = ∫ξ'(η)dμ' for all test forms) and every Lipschitz f : ℝ^P → ℝ, for L¹-a.e. t ∈ ℝ, every pair of currents A ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P), B ∈ 𝒟_d(ℝ^P) with A(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ(ω)dμ and B(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ'(η)dμ' for all test forms has ∂A − B integer multiplicity. If C ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P) has ∂C = 0 and ISP, μ is a Borel measure on ℝ^P with μ(K) < ∞ for compact K and μ(W) = M_W(C) for every open W, and ξ is a μ-a.e. strongly measurable field of (d+1)-vectors with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for μ-a.e. x and C(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ for every test form ω, then liminf_{r↓0} μ(B_r(x))/(ω_{d+1}r^{d+1}) ≥ η₀ for μ-a.e. x (ω_{d+1} = unitBallVolume (d+1)).
